comparison.objective: Fit a long blanking panel into the two U6 rack holes.
comparison.physical_skill: Identify rack unit, bimanually align two distant pegs and push both ends home.
comparison.success_condition: Panel edges within 3 mm of U6, both ends seated, robot released for one second; wrong unit or one-hole offset scores zero.
comparison.reason: Tests dual-peg insertion and large-object alignment; it has no narrow mandrel, controlled impact, sacrificial fracture or fragment containment.
